name: Steady & Strong
about: Steady & Strong is balance-first training for later life: simple self-tests to see where you stand, chair workouts, a balance programme that progresses from wall to no hands, and walking plans that build up without a wobble.
persona: You are a calm falls-prevention physio and strength coach for older adults: safety first, one progression at a time, cheerful, and always clear about what should be checked by a doctor.

onboarding.title: Stronger for the life you want
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us how you're moving now.
bullets: Self-tests that show where you stand

tools.title: Chair workout
tools.subtitle: 10–20 minutes, no floor
tools.prompt: A {minutes}-minute seated-and-standing-at-the-chair workout for {focus}, respecting the profile conditions: steps (exercise · reps or seconds · one form cue each), a table (Exercise | Easier version | Harder version), and a callout on stopping signs (chest pain, dizziness, sharp joint pain) and keeping the chair against a wall.

tools.title: Balance training
tools.subtitle: Progress from wall to no hands
tools.prompt: A 4-week balance programme starting at '{level}' for the profile: a table (Week | Exercises | Support used | Hold time | Days per week), steps for safe set-up (kitchen counter, phone within reach, shoes), bullets on how to know you're ready to progress, and a callout on what to do if you feel a wobble.

tools.title: Walking plan
tools.subtitle: Steps, pace, routes

inputs.label: Current walking
inputs.placeholder: to the shop and back, about 10 minutes, twice a week

inputs.label: Goal
inputs.placeholder: walk the seafront with the grandkids, 45 minutes

tools.prompt: Build a 6-week walking plan from '{now}' toward '{goal}' for the profile: a table (Week | Walks | Minutes each | Pace cue | Rest days), bullets on footwear, weather and where to sit down en route, a kv (Warning signs to stop | What to carry | Best time of day), and a quote with a one-line motivation for the fridge.

tools.title: Test where I stand
tools.subtitle: Three 2-minute self-tests

inputs.label: Results so far (optional)
inputs.placeholder: chair stand 9; up-and-go 14 seconds; tandem 6 s

tools.prompt: Run the {which} for the profile, with any results already recorded: {results}. Steps to perform each chosen test safely at home (equipment, exact set-up, what counts as one rep or a fail, someone nearby), a table (Test | My result | Typical range for my age | What it means), a kv (Strongest area | Area to work on | Re-test date in 4 weeks | Which tool in this app to use next), and a callout on results that mean stop and see a doctor or physio rather than train (e.g. can't stand once without hands, up-and-go over 15 seconds, dizziness).

tools.title: Stiff or sore today
tools.subtitle: Adjust, don't skip

inputs.label: What's going on
inputs.placeholder: knee stiff after gardening; low energy

tools.prompt: Given: {what}, adapt today's movement for the profile: a text section on move vs rest, steps for a 5-minute gentle mobility sequence that avoids the sore area, bullets of what to skip today, and a callout on symptoms that need a doctor (swelling, heat, unexplained weakness, a fall).

disclaimer: Not medical advice. Check with your doctor or physiotherapist before starting a new exercise programme, especially after a fall, surgery or with heart or balance conditions.
